outline.section: H2: What Is SLS and Why Do Some People Avoid It in Toothpaste?
outline.guidance: Explain that sodium lauryl sulfate is a synthetic surfactant used to create foam and help distribute paste across teeth. It is derived from lauryl alcohol (often palm or coconut-based) but is chemically processed into a harsh detergent form. Cover: (1) why manufacturers add it — cost, foam sensation, consumer expectation; (2) why it is controversial — studies linking SLS to increased canker sore recurrence, disruption of oral mucosa, and irritation for people with dry mouth or oral sensitivity; (3) that it is not necessary for effective cleaning — toothpaste cleans primarily through abrasion and active ingredients, not foam. Keep the tone educational and confident. Do not name competitor brands. Reference the internal blog post on SLS in toothpaste here.

outline.guidance: Identify specific audience segments who benefit most from switching: (1) people with recurrent canker sores — cite the clinical connection between SLS and aphthous ulcer frequency; (2) people with sensitive teeth or gum sensitivity; (3) people using prescription oral rinses where SLS can interfere with efficacy; (4) people with dry mouth conditions; (5) anyone following a clean or natural personal care routine who wants to eliminate unnecessary synthetic chemicals. Keep this scannable — use a short bulleted or numbered structure within the prose. Include a transition sentence at the end that bridges to what to look for in a brand.

Cover: (1) the primary name to look for — 'sodium lauryl sulfate'; (2) common aliases — sodium laurilsulfate, SLS, SLES (sodium laureth sulfate, a milder but related compound); (3) where it typically appears in the ingredient list (near the top if high concentration); (4) the difference between SLS and SLES — SLES is less irritating but still a synthetic sulfate that some clean-beauty shoppers prefer to avoid; (5) ingredients that indicate a genuinely SLS free formula — coconut oil, xylitol, baking soda, hydroxyapatite, aloe vera. This section should make the reader feel empowered to shop smarter. Include a CTA to the SLS free toothpaste collection after this section.
